rules.statement: The RTL must comply with VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2 (REF-003) without local exceptions.

The RTL must follow the REF-003 items listed: one module per file, structural top, ANSI ports, naming prefixes, FSM names and ENUM_ST_* states, PARA_SFIFO_* parameters, name and comment length limits, u_dont_touch_ instance names.
Every flop of the control state must have an asynchronous reset; the memory is the only resetless storage.
SVA, testbench or prototype code must not be in the synthesis file list.
The library SRAM and its macro model must be located in 000_Common, not in the folder of this IP.
m_vlsit_sfifo_ram_macro is instantiated as u_ram_macro in m_vlsit_sfifo_mem only when PARA_SFIFO_MEM_USE_MACRO = 1.
The hierarchy must have top m_vlsit_sfifo_top with instances u_wr, u_rd and u_mem of modules wr, rd and mem.
State ownership: wr owns write pointer, flags, FSM and read-pointer/ack retiming flops; rd owns read-side equivalents; mem owns storage.
The design must have no register logic and no protocol adapter.
o_wr_ptr is a flop output that changes only at the write-clock edge that accepts a write, and resets to 0.
o_mem_wr_en is 1 combinationally when a write is accepted, and the memory stores at the same edge as the pointer increments.
o_mem_wr_addr equals the write pointer modulo the depth.
o_mem_wr_data is a copy of i_wr_data in the same cycle.
o_req_wr is a flop output, reset to 0, set with the busy flop and cleared when REL starts.
Cross-domain inputs i_rd_ptr, i_wr_ptr, i_ack_rd and i_req_wr are captured by one retiming flop when PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME = 1, otherwise used directly.
o_rd_ptr is a flop output that changes only at the read-clock edge that accepts a read, and resets to 0.
o_mem_rd_addr is combinationally the next read pointer modulo the depth (show-ahead), based on the pointer and i_rd_en, valid every cycle.
i_mem_rd_data is the registered memory output, valid one cycle after the address.
o_ack_rd is a flop output reset to 0, and is 1 from the edge that leaves RST until the edge that leaves ACK.
The memory samples i_wr_en, i_wr_addr and i_wr_data at the write-port clock; i_wr_en qualifies address and data.
The memory samples i_rd_addr in every read-clock cycle.
Memory o_rd_data is registered and returns the word at the read address one read-clock cycle later; a word written at the same edge is not seen.
The macro samples write address and data at the write clock when active-low i_wr_en_n is 0.
The memory module ties macro i_rd_en_n to 0.
The macro samples i_rd_addr every cycle and registers o_rd_data one read-clock cycle after the address.
Macro wrapper pin names follow the library style of VLSIT_CELL_SRAM_1W1R and are exempt from the naming rule.
Synthesis uses top m_vlsit_sfifo_top with the four design files, and the 000_Common wrapper and cell for CFG-MACRO; memory is a flop array by default.
Lint uses the project lint set with default_nettype none checking.
